name: Her Choice
source:
Just as you are getting acquainted with your new life in Wingate, you receive an unexpected invitation: spend one week (all-expenses-paid) on the set of your favorite drama, tour the shooting locations and meet the actors, have we mentioned it’s all-expenses-paid? It’s a once-in-a-lifetime chance to experience the world of celebrities, and, who knows, take your fanfiction to the next level!

But the set is nothing like you imagined it to be, and the romantic and alluring façade that bewitched millions of fans might be just that, a façade.

The dark, tangled world that lies behind those shiny gates will bring back a secret to haunt you from the past you have tried very hard to leave behind …

Who are you? Why were you invited to the set?

There is only one person who knows the truth …

[From [url=https://totes-studio-p.itch.io/herchoice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚开始适应在Wingate的新生活，就收到一份意外邀请：免费食宿一周，前往你最喜欢的电视剧片场，参观拍摄地点、和演员见面。刚才提过了吧，所有费用全包？这是体验明星世界的一生难逢机会；谁知道呢，说不定还能把你的同人小说写得更上一层楼！

然而，片场和你想象的完全不同；那迷住数百万粉丝的浪漫迷人表象，或许只是表象。

光鲜大门背后，是一个阴暗而错综复杂的世界。它会揭开一段秘密，让你再次被竭力想要抛在过去的往事纠缠……

你是谁？为什么会受邀来到片场？

只有一个人知道真相……

[来源：[url=https://totes-studio-p.itch.io/herchoice]itch.io[/url]]
